messages:
maria-chen: Quick check — I opened a draft PR to normalize the customer-facing audit event lexicon and a small validation endpoint. Need alignment on: naming patterns, required metadata (user_id vs actor_id), versioning, and what to redact for PCI/PII. Link in thread.
alex-w: thanks. can you paste the PR link? also curious how this intersects with the RBAC changes we shipped last week.
samir: here — was skimming. main thing for KMS: do we include key_id in the event or only key_alias? risking sensitive exposures.
maria-chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 :eyes: — RBAC mapping is a separate PR but we should ensure event names map to roles for policy coverage checks.
lee: naming nit: prefer "resource.action" (e.g., model.deploy) over verbs-only. it's easier to group by resource in dashboards and for customer queries.
priya-k: +1 on resource.action. also we should have an event_version header in the payload and a schema_url so older clients can be validated.
julian: customer-facing = we need human-readable summary + machine name. maybe "display_name" + "event" fields so we can show friendly text in the console without leaking internal nouns.
alex-w: how do we handle sensitive fields? example: model.source_repo or commit_sha could leak internal details.
priya-k: redact commit_sha and any full path. allow truncated or hashed values (sha256 prefix) and mark in schema as "redacted": true.
samir: for KMS: include key_alias (string) and key_fingerprint (hash) but not the raw key_id. KMS audit logs already include detailed identifiers internally; customer events should be minimal.
maria-chen: rough example schema in the PR (excerpt):
```
{
  "event": "model.deploy",
  "event_version": "1",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T18:02:00Z",
  "actor": { "actor_id": "u_12345", "display_name": "alex-w" },
  "resource": { "type": "model", "resource_id": "m_98765", "display_name": "llama-13b-finetuned" },
  "details": { "strategy": "blue-green", "notes": "redacted_commit_prefix: abcd1234" },
  "kms": { "key_alias": "projects/rdw/keys/customer-1", "key_fingerprint": "sha256:..." }
}
```
lee: looks good. add a top-level "visibility" enum: [internal, customer, redacted] so consumers can filter events for UIs or exports.
priya-k: +1. also include a canonical_event_name and a human_message template with placeholders so translations and UI text are consistent.
julian: validation endpoint idea: POST event -> returns 200 + warnings/errors. we can use it in CI for customers to validate audit ingestion before enabling exports.
alex-w: can we add a lint job to fail CI when a new event doesn't have schema_url, event_version, visibility, and canonical_event_name? would avoid regressions.
maria-chen: yes. i'll add a checklist to the PR. also note: cross-team consumers (billing, compliance, console) will need a mapping doc. @eng-platform and @security please review the mapping section.
audit-bot: New spec PR created: platform/pull/4123 — reviewers requested: @eng-platform, @security :thumbsup:
lee: quick runtime concern: telemetry volume — for high-cardinality fields (resource_id), ensure we index only when visibility==internal to avoid noisy metrics.
priya-k: good point. we'll keep customer exports aggregated by resource_type, not id, unless customer explicitly opts in.
samir: for KMS integration tests, I'll add a fake-key flow to the test harness and include expected masked outputs.
maria-chen: timeline: aim to land schema v1 next week; if no major blockers, add lint and validation endpoint in follow-up. please leave review comments on the PR. thanks everyone :heart:
